## **Life Story**

Arline Stone was born on February 22, 1938, according to a family tree, the daughter of William and Ruth Stone. ** \[UNPROVED\]** She married Earl Brewster while still a teenager, and by July 1953, when Earl was a Marine machine-gunner in Korea, she was living with his parents on East 12th Street in Cincinnati; the newspaper report of his wounding on the war’s last day named her as "Mrs. Arlene Brewster." ** \[DOCUMENTED\]** Back home, Earl worked as a printer, and their daughter Cheryl Ann was born in Cincinnati in 1956\. ** \[DOCUMENTED\]** Their son Earl Jr. is remembered in the family as Earl’s boy. ** \[FAMILY ACCOUNT\]**

In March 1959 Earl was killed when his car left the road in Kentucky, leaving Arline a widow at twenty-one with small children. ** \[DOCUMENTED\]** By 1961 she had married Wilkie Gayhart, and their daughter Kristy was born on Christmas Day that year. ** \[SUPPORTED\]** Arline was the mother of six children, and she stayed in Cincinnati; she outlived both Wilkie and her daughters Cheryl (2015) and Kristy (2025). ** \[DOCUMENTED\]**

2\. Obituary of Cheryl Ann Brewster Horne, Warlick Funeral Home, Lincolnton, North Carolina, posted 24 May 2015: born October 2, 1956, in Cincinnati "to Arline Stone Gayhart and the late Earl Brewster"; survived by "her mother, Arline Gayhart of Cincinnati," a brother Earl Brewster, and sisters Carolyn Coomes, Adele Bowen, Maureen Fields and Kristy Duckett (the heading misprints her birth year as 1946\) ** \[DOCUMENTED\]**

3\. Obituary of Kristy Ann (Gayhart) Duckett, Hodapp Funeral Homes, 2025: "born Kristy Ann Gayhart to Wilkie and Arline Gayhart on December 25, 1961, in Cincinnati"; died 18 December 2025; "survived by her mother, Arline Gayhart"; "preceded in death by her father, Wilkie Gayhart, and her sister, Cheryl Horne"; names her siblings Earl Brewster, Carolyn Coomes, Adele Bowen and Maureen Fields ** \[DOCUMENTED\]**

4\. Earl Brewster’s Kentucky death record and his VA grave marker, Spring Grove Cemetery: his death on 22 March 1959 ** \[DOCUMENTED\]**

5\. Geni, Arline Gayhart (Stone), read 6 November 2026: born February 22, 1938 (no place); parents William Stone and Ruth Stone; widow of Earl Brewster; six children; no sources, documents or photos attached (tree lead only) ** \[UNPROVED\]**

6\. 1940 U.S. census, Cincinnati, Ward 6, 1307 (rear) Pendleton Street: William Stone 30, Ruth 29, May Ellen 8, Arline 3 (FamilySearch, ark:/61903/1:1:KWPD-SBP) ** \[DOCUMENTED\]**

## **Research Notes and Open Questions**

• Marriage records: Earl Brewster × Arline Stone, about 1952–53 (Hamilton County, Ohio, or Kenton or Campbell County, Kentucky); Wilkie Gayhart × Arline Brewster, about 1959–61. Either would confirm her parents and birth date.

• Birth: check the Ohio Birth Index for an Arline (or Arlene) Stone born 22 February 1938 to confirm the Geni date and her parents William and Ruth Stone.

• Half-sister: William Stone's first wife, Helen Margaret (Abel) Stone, died 1 June 1932, six days after May Ellen was born. Ruth, the wife in 1940, was a stepmother to May Ellen, so Arline is most likely Ruth's daughter and May Ellen's half-sister. A William Stone × Ruth marriage (about 1933–36) would give Ruth's maiden name; Geni's "Corey" is not proved, and "Spriggs" belongs to a different Stone family.

• Birth year: the 1940 census gives her age as 3 in April 1940, which points to 1936–37, not Geni's 1938\.

• Wilkie Gayhart: his dates are not known and no obituary has been found yet.

• Paternity of Maureen, Carolyn and Adele: Ohio birth records for each child would settle which were Earl’s and which Wilkie’s. Maureen Fields and Adele Bowen are definitely Earl’s daughters; only Carolyn Coomes’s father is still unproved.

• Spelling: "Arlene" in the 1953 newspaper; "Arline" in both obituaries and on Geni. The later spelling is used here.

• Photo placed 7 November 2026, from a family photo.

• Arline’s profile is filed in Earl Brewster’s folder, like other spouses in their partner’s folder.
